items.en_title: Extrema (MG) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #000022
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Extrema (MG) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,400,000; proposals close Nov 19, 16:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
